headline: The RSM Classic: Round 1 underway at Sea Island with 2027 PGA Tour cards on the line
teaser: Opening round action is officially underway on the Georgia coast as players battle for crucial FedExCup points, full-status top-125 exemptions, and signature event invites.
story:
Round 1 of The RSM Classic got underway under ideal coastal conditions on Thursday morning, 19 November, at Sea Island Golf Club on St. Simons Island, Georgia, launching the dramatic finale of the PGA Tour's FedExCup Fall.

Hosted by Davis Love III, the tournament represents the final chance for competitors to earn top-125 positioning in the FedExCup standings and guarantee fully exempt playing privileges for the 2027 campaign. Early action across the Seaside Course saw local resident Davis Thompson ignite the leaderboard with a blistering 5-under-par start through 14 holes, firing six birdies against a lone bogey.

Two-time RSM Classic champion Mackenzie Hughes and Bermuda Championship winner Austin Smotherman are among the early pacesetters at 4-under par, while bubble contenders like Joel Dahmen and Zac Blair battle with immense tension where every single stroke carries massive career stakes.
whyCareReason: Round 1 is live at Sea Island as players fight for the final top-125 exemptions for the 2027 PGA Tour season.
stakes: Top-125 cutoff locks in full tour cards for 2027, while Nos. 51-60 qualify for AT&T Pebble Beach and The Genesis Invitational.
rivalryAngle: High-pressure survival golf along the Atlantic marshes where every putt alters the projected FedExCup bubble standings in real time.
funFacts: The RSM Classic uses both the Seaside and Plantation courses for the opening two rounds before the Seaside hosts the weekend.
Davis Love III has hosted the event since its inception at Sea Island in 2010.
Mackenzie Hughes is a two-time champion at Sea Island, winning in 2016 and 2022.
